must / should · 专项练习(第3轮): must expresses obligation or strong inference; should gives advice; both take the base verb.本课为专项练习练习,核心:Modal verbs are followed by the base verb; mustn't indicates prohibition。

must + base verb: obligation|should + base verb: suggestion, advice|mustn't expresses prohibition|needn't / don't have to express 'no need'|should have + past participle expresses blame about the past
